question: An alternating voltage $v(t) = 2.0 \sin(\omega t) \text{ V}$ is applied to a half-wave rectifier circuit containing a single Silicon diode (cut-in voltage $V_k = 1.0 \text{ V}$ for this specific heavily doped diode) and a load resistor. For what fraction of the total time period ($T$) of the AC cycle does the diode actually conduct current?
